capacity.interpretation: deployed capacity proxy, not realized passengers

limitations: No correction for unobserved passenger selection.
Candidate content screens are not semantic labels; raw lexical extremity is not evaluation intensity.
Author equalization of sampled labels targets observed sampled authors only.
Capacity targets are not passenger counts; missing cells are never silently renormalized.
No label validation, error-bound propagation, bootstrap or inferential pretrend equivalence test executed.
units: tone in [-1,1], shares in [0,1]; multiply differences by 100 for percentage/index points
